title: The Last Span
synopsis: A-Yu wants only one thing: to cross the river and find her mother. But the Iron Gator King rules the water, and even Granny Qingshui's ferry can carry just one passenger at a time. When A-Yu asks a reluctant carpenter to repair the broken bridge, a child's hope becomes a test of fear, courage, and what it takes to bring two shores together.
awards: Official Selection — Bali International AI Film Festival (BIAIFF) Season 5 2026
Best Story — Astana AI Film Festival (AAIFF) 2026
